description: This file defines extension methods for tasks with timeout capabilities and utility functions for handling SiloAddress instances within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: TestExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension method for executing tasks with a timeout.

classes.name: SiloAddressUtils
classes.description: Contains utility functions for creating local SiloAddress instances.

methods.name: WithTimeout
methods.description: Executes a task with a specified timeout, throwing a TimeoutException if the task does not complete in time.

methods.name: NewLocalSiloAddress
methods.description: Creates a new local SiloAddress with a specified generation number.
